items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: Well, Baby Dodge... He played with... What Fade Merrill was banned before Zutty and those guys... Played on... On the Sidney. Mm-hmm. When Louis Armstrong played with the band, you know?

ctx.x: Well, how did Baby Dodge rate in those days? When you were down in New Orleans?

Well, Baby Dodge... He played with... What Fade Merrill was banned before Zutty and those guys... Played on... On the Sidney. Mm-hmm. When Louis Armstrong played with the band, you know? Mm-hmm. And he... He played... New Orleans drums. I don't know whether he could read or not. I mean...
